title: School Management ERP
description: AI-powered school management ERP covering enrollment, attendance, examinations, fees, teachers, reporting and an administrative dashboard.
businessObjectives: Replace spreadsheet-based administration for a mid-sized school
Give the principal a real-time dashboard of attendance and fee collection

functionalRequirements.text: Student enrollment with guardian details and class assignment
Daily attendance capture per class session with absence reports
Fee schedules, invoices and payment status tracking

nonFunctionalRequirements.text: Role-based access control for admin, teacher and parent roles
All state-changing endpoints covered by automated tests

expectedDeliverables: Source code in the project repository

acceptanceCriteria.text: Project builds from a clean checkout
Each functional requirement is demonstrably implemented

requiredIntegrations.purpose: Read team assignments and deadlines for progress reporting
